title: Rhythm Tengoku
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 4033 (translation hash linked; addresses converted to GBA bus addresses)

rows: press A (or A + B) on the beat; results: Try Again, OK, Superb

widgets.text: Karate Man, Clappy Trio, Rhythm Tweezers, Space Dance, Sneaky Spirits, Night Walk, Ninja Bodyguard, Tap Trial and more
Listen rather than look: every game uses audio cues

rows: get Superb on a game to earn a medal

widgets.text:
Stages of 4 games, each closed by a Remix of them
Later stages bring harder '2' versions of earlier games
Medals unlock Rhythm Toys and Endless games in the Café
One medal per Superb rank; Perfect campaigns award special items

Stage clears; Remix 6 is the finale
English translation in the Translations folder; version Beta 13a (from the file name; an early or partial patch, so some text may still be Japanese)
